ETH Outperformed BTC Today, but ETFs Have Seen 7 Straight Days of Outflows: I’m Calling It “Relative Strength,” Not a Reversal for Now

After the election results came in, the market fell and then rallied. Of the three major coins, ETH had the strongest rebound.

Binance spot data (11/4, 19:26 Taipei time): ETH was around 2,333, up 2.8% over 24 hours, rebounding about 4.8% from its low of 2,226; BTC was around 78,638, up 1.9%, with its low of 75,736 marking a 40-day low; SOL was around 93.9, up 1.4%, the weakest of the three. ETH/BTC returned to 0.0297, above every daily close since 10/17.

But fund flows haven’t followed. Farside data shows that U.S. spot ETH ETFs saw net outflows for seven consecutive trading days from 10/26 to 11/3, totaling about $656 million. On 11/3 alone, outflows were $85.3 million, including $74.4 million from ETHA. BTC ETFs also saw net outflows of $116 million on 11/3. The Fear & Greed Index rose from 26 to 34, but remains in fear territory.

What does this mean?
Today’s strength in ETH looks more like risk-on positioning after the election, combined with a rebound after the steep declines of the past few days. Compared with a month ago (the 10/5 close), ETH is still down 14%, BTC is down 9%, and SOL is down 23%. Price has moved first, while ETFs are still selling. The biggest risk for a rebound like this is that it lasts “only one day.”

My take: ETH is worth watching more closely now, but I wouldn’t call this a trend reversal yet. The conditions I’m watching are threefold: ETH/BTC holds above 0.0296; ETH ETFs record at least one day of net inflows; and ETH climbs back above the 10/28 close of 2,360. Until all three conditions are met, today is just “relative strength,” not “the start of a rally.”

Whales aren’t buying the dip—they’re selling altcoins and buying BTC and ETH

A $62.97 million ETH buy appeared on-chain this week, and many thought a whale was buying the dip. But it later emerged that the buying address may be linked to a crypto hack. The transaction may have been intended to move funds, so it shouldn’t be treated as a bullish signal.

What’s really worth watching is where the money is flowing: a whale sold 1.02 million SOL, worth about $104 million, and another address transferred 1.49 million SOL to an exchange. Large transfers of AAVE, WLD, and HYPE to exchanges were also observed.

Meanwhile, Tether added 50,000 BTC to its holdings, while companies including Strategy, Strive, Block, and Coinbase also increased their BTC positions. Some funds bought ETH at lower prices.

In short, big-money investors weren’t buying the dip across the board this week. They were adjusting their portfolios: reducing altcoin holdings and increasing BTC and ETH. Following the flow of funds is more important than fixating on a single whale buy.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scaling out to take profits: How to secure gains while letting profits run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than setting a stop loss, because a stop loss cuts through fear, while taking profits means curbing greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell, then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scaling-out strategy I've been using to take profits.

[Three stages] Stage one: At the first target (for example, a 1:1 risk-reward ratio), reduce your position by 1/3 to lock in some profits,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose money, and your mindset changes immediately. Stage two: At the second target
(for example, a 2:1 risk-reward ratio), sell another 1/3. Stage three: Use a trailing stop for the rest; exit if it falls below the moving average
or the previous low, and let your profits run.

[Why this works] Selling your entire position too soon leaves you kicking yourself, while holding the whole position often means riding the elevator all the way back down and giving back your gains.

The ETH Block Access List Is Still Under Review | Price Returns to Around $2,330 | I’m Waiting for Confirmation, Not Chasing Headlines

My stance is cautiously bullish, but I’m not treating the protocol draft as a benefit that has already materialized. Ethereum’s official EIP page shows that the EIP-7928 Block-Level Access Lists proposal is still in Last Call. It proposes recording account and storage access, along with post-transaction state changes, during block execution, providing the basis for parallel reads, verification, and state-root calculations. A newly opened PR #12611 in the EIPs repository on November 2 points out a boundary case: in a static execution environment, certain instructions that would modify state should halt first, before determining whether to include the target in the access list. The author says existing tests already reflect this behavior and that the changes mainly fill out the specification text; the page still shows Open, awaiting review by the author. This is a clarification of the proposal text—not a mainnet upgrade happening today, and no reason to assume fees will fall immediately.

Why am I still watching it? A chain’s long-term value comes not only from market performance, but also from whether nodes can reliably and quickly recheck blocks. If access lists are ultimately adopted and implemented, they could theoretically reduce bottlenecks from serial disk reads. But that would require client implementations, testing, and upgrade planning, and actual performance would also depend on workloads and hardware. From an investment perspective, potential performance gains cannot be equated directly with buying demand for ETH. The Farside table shows net outflows of $85.3 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 3, U.S. time, and $139.7 million on November 2, suggesting institutional channels have not provided a tailwind recently. The table updates automatically, so figures may be revised.

The market has shown another side: when I checked Kraken ETH/USD, the price was around $2,329.64, above the daily open of $2,271.67, with a 24-hour range of approximately $2,223.35 to $2,331.83. The price recovery is reflected in actual quotes, but that does not prove it was driven by this PR; broader risk appetite, the preceding decline, and exchange liquidity are more likely to have acted together, so I won’t attribute it to any single factor. The next level to watch is around $2,332, the intraday high just reached; $2,223 is the lower bound I’m watching in this move. If the price falls back below the daily open and fails to recover it, I’ll withdraw my cautiously bullish view for now. If the proposal is officially closed or implementation by core clients runs into obstacles, the long-term narrative will also need to be reassessed.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter right now. I’d only consider a small, unleveraged spot position to test the waters on the long side, and would never open a futures position just because of PR wording. Only if ETH holds above $2,332 for a full hour, pulls back without breaking below it, and I confirm that ETH mainnet deposits and withdrawals are operating normally on the exchange I’m using, would I risk at most 2% of my total funds on a test position. The initial target would be $2,360, where I’d first take half off; I’d watch $2,390 for the remainder, with a stop-loss below $2,308. If the price falls through the stop after entry, I’d close the entire position. If it reaches the target first but then falls back below $2,332, I’d close the remaining position. If the conditions aren’t met, I stay out—no trade and no profit. This leaves room for misreading the news and sudden liquidity shifts.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH区块访问清单仍在审稿｜价格回到2330美元附近｜我等确认，不追消息

我的态度是谨慎偏多，但现在不把协议草案当成已经兑现的利好。以太坊官方EIP页面显示，EIP-7928区块级访问清单仍处于Last Call；它拟在区块执行时记录账户和存储位置的访问及交易后的状态变化，为并行读取、验证和状态根计算提供条件。11月2日EIPs仓库新开的PR #12611指出一个边界：在静态执行环境里，某些会改写状态的指令应先停止，再判断是否把目标写入访问清单。作者称现有测试已体现该行为，修改主要是补齐规范文字；页面仍显示Open、等待作者审阅。这是提案文本的精确化，绝非主网今天升级，也不能据此推断手续费马上下降。

为什么我仍关注它？一条链的长期价值不仅来自行情，还来自节点能否可靠、快速地复核区块。访问清单若最终被采纳并实现，理论上可减少串行读盘的瓶颈；但需要客户端实现、测试、升级安排，实际性能也取决于负载和硬件。投资上更不能把潜在性能直接等同于ETH买盘。Farside表中美国时间11月3日ETH现货基金合计净流出8530万美元，11月2日净流出1.397亿美元，说明机构渠道近期尚未提供顺风；该表自动更新，数字可能修订。

市场已经给出另一面：我查看Kraken ETH/USD时约2329.64美元，高于日开2271.67美元，24小时区间约2223.35至2331.83美元。价格修复是真实报价，但并不能证明由这份PR推动；更可能是整体风险偏好、前期跌幅和交易所流动性共同作用，我不做单一归因。接下来2332美元附近是刚触及的日内上沿，2223美元是本轮观察下沿；若重新跌回日开且无法收复，谨慎偏多判断先撤销。若官方关闭提案、核心客户端实现受阻，长期叙事也要重估。

如果是我自己交易，当前不参与，方向只考虑无杠杆现货轻仓试多，绝不因PR字眼开合约。只有ETH在2332美元上方连续一小时收稳、回踩不破，并确认所用交易所ETH主网充提正常，才用总资金最多2%试单；初步目标2360美元，到位先减半，剩余看2390美元，止损放在2308美元下方。若触发后跌破止损就全部平仓；若先到目标后又跌回2332美元下方，剩余仓位平掉。条件未触发就是空仓，没有成交，更没有盈利。这样做是为消息误读和突发流动性留出余地。

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月四日，以太坊现货价格报二千三百二十八点七一美元，过去二十四小时内上涨约百分之二点二二。价格从二千二百四十四美元的支撑位强势反弹，连续突破多条均线压制，展现出较强的上攻动能。从小时级别K线来看，以太坊在过去五个小时内稳步攀升，从二千二百九十七美元附近逐步上涨至二千三百二十八美元上方，多头控盘迹象明显。

本轮上涨的主要驱动力来自机构层面的利好消息。莫斯科交易所宣布将于十二月一日上线以太坊交易，同时Bullish平台的代币化股票整合也在推进中，这些消息极大地提振了市场对以太坊机构采用前景的信心。此外，LeanVM实现端到端形式化验证的技术里程碑，也从架构层面增强了市场对以太坊长期安全性的信心。

从成交量来看，以太坊在上涨过程中伴随着明显的放量，最高单小时成交额达到三千六百四十五万美元，显示出资金入场的积极性。然而，需要注意的是，美国以太坊ETF近期持续出现资金净流出，单日净流出达八千五百三十万美元，贝莱德更是将约六万三千六百枚以太坊转移至机构托管账户，这在一定程度上反映出机构投资者的短期获利了结行为。

二、技术指标解读

从技术指标来看，以太坊当前呈现出较强的多头格局。移动平均线系统显示明确的上升趋势，七周期均线报二千三百一十三点八七美元，二十五周期均线报二千二百九十点四四美元，九十九周期均线报二千二百七十二点四一美元，三条均线呈现完美的多头排列。当前价格位于所有均线上方，短线支撑强劲。

MACD指标表现亮眼，柱状图持续扩大至正值五点五四，DIF线报十二点四九，DEA线报六点九四，两线均向上发散，显示上升动能充沛。RSI六周期指标报八十点五一，已进入严重超买区域，短线存在技术性回调的可能。布林带上轨报二千三百三十七点五五美元，当前价格接近上轨，若能有效突破，可能打开进一步上涨空间。

KDJ指标显示K值已达九十点四零，D值报八十一点六四，J值报一百零七点九二，三线均处于高位运行，表明市场处于强势状态但也面临超买压力。威廉指标报负五点一二，同样处于超买区域。随机RSI指标报九十九点七二，几乎达到极值，提示短线需要警惕回调风险。

从波动率来看，十四周期ATR报十六点七五，较前期有所下降，表明市场波动性正在收敛。标准差指标持续走低，五周期标准差仅为九点一八，暗示市场可能在酝酿一波方向性突破。

三、市场情绪分析

当前以太坊市场情绪整体偏多。机构采用方面的利好消息不断涌现，莫斯科交易所即将上线以太坊交易，代币化股票的发展也为以太坊生态带来新的应用场景。技术层面的突破进一步增强了市场信心，价格成功站上多条关键均线，形成较强的技术支撑。

然而，市场也面临一些不确定因素。美国中期选举带来的政策不确定性依然存在，民主党对加密货币的监管态度可能更加严格。ETF资金持续流出反映出部分机构投资者选择在高价位获利了结，这可能对短期价格形成压力。此外，当前多项技术指标显示以太坊已进入超买区域，短线存在回调修正的技术需求。

从链上数据来看，以太坊网络的活跃度保持稳健，开发者社区持续活跃，生态建设稳步推进。长期来看，以太坊作为智能合约平台的龙头地位依然稳固，机构采用的持续推进将为价格提供坚实支撑。

综合来看，以太坊短线处于强势上涨格局，但超买指标提示需要警惕回调风险。投资者应关注二千三百美元附近的支撑力度，以及能否有效突破二千三百四十美元阻力位。在操作策略上，建议已持仓者继续持有，未入场者等待回调后再考虑布局。

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Too close, and you’ll get stopped out every day; too far, and one loss can really hurt.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. Simple and straightforward, suitable for beginners
and helps build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop may end up right where other traders’ stops are clustered.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the structure becomes invalid: for a long position, below key support; for a short position,
above resistance. The logic is—if this level breaks, it’s evidence that I was wrong.

translatedData.content:
If you trade on a licensed platform in Hong Kong, will your transaction records be “automatically” reported to the tax authority in the future—or even exchanged with the place where you are a tax resident? The Legislative Council set the timeline in stone today.

On November 4, the Legislative Council passed the Inland Revenue (Amendment) (Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework and Amended Common Reporting Standard) Bill 2026. The government welcomed the move in a statement issued the same day: it brings the OECD’s Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF) and the latest amendments to the Common Reporting Standard (CRS) into Hong Kong law.

Here are a few points that matter directly to ordinary people 👇

🔹 First, distinguish “reporting” from “Hong Kong suddenly imposing capital gains tax on crypto trading.” Hong Kong generally does not tax capital gains. The main aim of this change is tax transparency: service providers collect information, and the Inland Revenue Department automatically exchanges it with partner jurisdictions on a reciprocal basis to help combat cross-border tax evasion. It does not introduce a new local tax rate of “pay tax on whatever you gain.”

🔹 The timeline is clear: CARF takes effect next year (according to the Inland Revenue Department’s public information, on January 1, 2027). From then on, crypto-asset service providers with a Hong Kong connection that meet the reporting requirements will have to register, conduct due diligence and report. The Inland Revenue Department expects to begin exchanging tax information related to crypto-asset transactions with partner jurisdictions from 2028. The amended CRS takes effect on January 1, 2028, with the exchange of financial account information under the new standard expected to begin in 2029.

🔹 Who has to report, and what gets reported? Service providers that, as a business, exchange crypto for fiat or crypto for crypto on behalf of customers, or provide a platform for trading, are reportable crypto-asset service providers. The relevant reportable transactions fall into three categories: crypto-to-fiat exchanges, crypto-to-crypto exchanges, and transfers (including reportable retail payment transactions, user transfers and transfers to external wallets). Common actions on the user side include providing a tax-residency “self-certification” when opening an account; existing customers will also have a window to provide this information.

🔹 What does this mean for you? Whether you are overseas with an account at a service provider connected to Hong Kong, or the other way around, if you are identified as a reportable user or reportable person, information such as the total transaction amount, number of transactions and asset names may enter the automatic-exchange system. Managing your own assets in a cold wallet and not trading through these service providers is generally outside the “service provider reports on your behalf” system. But once you trade through a platform or withdraw to an external address, a record may be made. Details will depend on the Inland Revenue Department’s subsequent guidance and the list of partner jurisdictions.

🔹 How the pieces fit together: the “virtual asset custody/advisory licences” that sparked discussion earlier today are a separate track (whether those holding private keys or giving trading advice need a licence); this is the Inland Revenue Department’s CARF/CRS track. Both are moving forward—don’t confuse them as “the same new tax.”

Put simply: first get clear on your tax-residency status, what kind of service provider your account is with, and how to complete future self-certification. That’s more relevant to what you’ll actually need to do than focusing on whether taxes will “go up immediately.” The Inland Revenue Department has said it will issue guidance and set up a dedicated team to answer questions.

Are you more concerned that “the platform will ask for tax information again,” or about “how the information will be checked once it’s exchanged with your place of tax residence”? Share your thoughts in the comments 👇

#香港通过加密资产申报框架修订 #BTC #ETH

content:
在香港持牌平台买卖，自己的交易流水以后会不会被「自动」报到税务局、甚至换到你纳税居民所在地？立法会今天把时间表写死了。

11 月 4 日，立法会通过《2026 年税务（修订）（加密资产申报框架及经修订的共同汇报标准）条例草案》。政府同日发稿欢迎：这是把经合组织（OECD）的加密资产申报框架（CARF），以及共同汇报标准（CRS）的最新修订，落到香港本地法。

几个和普通人直接相关的点👇

🔹 先分清「申报」≠「香港突然开征炒币资本利得税」。香港一般不对资本收益征税；这次主轴是税务透明度——服务商收集资料，税务局按互惠原则与伙伴管辖区自动交换，用来协助打击跨境逃税，不是本地新开一张「涨多少交多少」的税率表

🔹 时间线写得很清楚：CARF 明年起实施（按税务局公开口径为 2027 年 1 月 1 日）。届时符合香港关联规则的申报加密资产服务提供者，要做登记、尽职审查和申报；税务局预计自 2028 年起，把加密资产交易相关税务资料与伙伴管辖区交换。经修订的 CRS 自 2028 年 1 月 1 日起实施，按新标准的财务账户资料交换预计 2029 年起

🔹 谁要报、报什么：作为业务为客户做加密↔法币兑换、加密↔加密兑换，或提供买卖平台的服务商，属申报加密资产服务提供者。须申报的相关交易分三类——加密与法币兑换、加密之间兑换、以及转让（包括须申报零售付款、使用者转移、提到外部钱包等）。用户侧常见动作是：开户时要交税务居民「自我证明」；老客户也有补交窗口

🔹 对你意味着什么：人在外地、账户开在有香港关联的服务商，或反过来——只要被识辨为须申报使用者／申报对象，累计交易金额、次数、资产名称等资料，就可能进入自动交换链条。自己冷钱包自管、且不经这些服务商成交的路径，通常不在「服务商代你申报」那一套里；但一旦经平台买卖、提现到外部地址，就可能被记上一笔。细节以税务局后续指引和伙伴管辖区名单为准

🔹 拼图位置：今天稍早热议的「虚拟资产托管／顾问牌照」是另一条线（谁握私钥、谁给买卖意见要不要持牌）；这条是税务局侧的 CARF／CRS。两条都在推进，别混成「同一条新税」

说白了：先搞清楚自己的税务居民身份、账户开在哪类服务商、以后自我证明怎么填——比盯着「会不会立刻加税」更贴近真实操作。税务局已说会发指引，并设专责小组答疑。

你更担心的是「平台要多要一次税务资料」，还是「资料被换回纳税地之后怎么查」？评论区聊聊👇

Golden and death crosses are everywhere; what matters is where the crossover occurs and what the preceding trend was.
MACD was first proposed by Gerald Appel. Its default settings are 12, 26, and 9, and it measures trend momentum using the difference between a fast and a slow EMA.
A death cross above the zero line is often interpreted as weakening upward momentum, but it doesn’t necessarily signal a trend reversal; a death cross below zero is often seen as a sign that the downtrend will continue.
Don’t chase trades during the most volatile few minutes. Wait for the candlestick to close and settle before assessing the situation.

My observation: this run of consecutive net outflows from spot Bitcoin ETFs looks more like the combined result of sentiment and position adjustments than a structural withdrawal of institutional capital. This assessment assumes that outflows narrow and on-chain accumulation continues; if BlackRock’s IBIT continues to see large outflows, the assessment will need to be revised.

First, the facts. Citing SoSoValue data, PANews reported that spot Bitcoin ETFs saw total net outflows of $116 million on November 3, U.S. Eastern Time, marking three consecutive days of net outflows. Outflows totaled $399 million on the previous trading day, including a single-day net outflow of $405 million from BlackRock’s IBIT. Bitwise’s BITB and Fidelity’s FBTC saw small net inflows, but these did not reverse the overall trend. Over the same period, Onchain Lens tracked addresses associated with BlackRock transferring approximately 7,244 BTC and 63,600 ETH to Coinbase Prime, worth around $702 million combined at the time. Cointelegraph reported that Bitwise’s André Dragosch attributed the outflows to weakening market sentiment and said institutions had broadly maintained their exposure.

It is important to distinguish between these points: ETF net outflows record changes in creations and redemptions; they do not mean that the Bitcoin corresponding to those shares was directly dumped on the spot market. Likewise, transfers from an address to an exchange are only one step in a potential flow of funds. The material available here does not say whether a trade took place or at what price. Dragosch’s claim that “institutional positioning has not changed” is an institutional view, not a verified fact.

On this basis, if outflows narrow going forward, IBIT stops seeing single-day redemptions worth hundreds of millions of dollars, and the “seller exhaustion” indicator cited by CryptoQuant remains low, the sentiment-driven hypothesis will be more convincing. Conversely, if IBIT continues to see large outflows alongside sustained transfers from addresses to exchanges, that should be treated as evidence that positions are being materially reduced. Yi Lihua’s $80,000 forecast and Markus Thielen’s prediction of $90,000 by year-end are both analysts’ opinions, not grounds for verification. I will track daily net ETF flows and IBIT-specific data rather than a single-day price rebound. This article does not constitute investment advice.

The primary question for $RENDER involves the strength of its current hourly direction. When price moves up and volume remains 2.14212, we observe active engagement. Comparing $RENDER to peers provides a useful contrast in how activity manifests. ETH shows an hourly direction up with volume staying below its baseline. In contrast, ZEC moves up with volume above its baseline. These variations show that while the broad market might move together, the intensity of participant interest varies significantly across different assets. A similar direction across these tokens is not a measured correlation or a sign of capital rotation. It is simply a snapshot of independent movements happening at the same time.

What matters most is whether the move holds. If $RENDER stays above 1.4863 while activity cools, the move may be stabilizing. If it fails to hold 1.5475, the recent volume might represent a temporary peak. One way to reassess this is to monitor the RSI at 61.9406 alongside the MACD at 0.0114085. Blockchain Industry | What are blobs, and why can they make Layer 2 cheaper?
When the Cancun upgrade went live, the target was 3 blobs per block, with a maximum of 6; the Pectra upgrade in May 2025 raised this to a target of 6 and a maximum of 9.
“Proto-Danksharding” is the first step toward full Danksharding: first, it establishes the transaction format and fee mechanism for blobs, with capacity to be expanded gradually later.
Layer 2 networks submit blob data to the mainnet, and the blob fees are also settled in $ETH .
Every return comes with corresponding risks. Make sure you understand how much you could lose in the worst case.

区块链行业｜blob 是什么，为什么能让二层变便宜？
坎昆升级上线时每个区块目标 3 个、最多 6 个 blob；2025 年 5 月的 Pectra 升级提高到目标 6 个、最多 9 个。
“Proto-Danksharding”是完整 Danksharding 的第一步：先将 blob 的交易格式和收费机制确定下来，容量之后再逐步扩大。
二层网络往主网提交 blob 数据，交的 blob 费也用 $ETH 结算。

Want to trade “single-stock perpetuals” on regulated U.S. venues? Maybe there’s finally no need to go offshore. This time, the CFTC chair has firmly opened the door.

On November 3, CFTC Chair Michael Selig issued a statement: under the securities futures framework of the Commodity Futures Modernization Act and Regulation 40.3, “Equity Perps” (perpetual futures linked to individual U.S. stocks) may be listed on designated contract markets registered with the CFTC and registered with the SEC, by way of notice, to trade security futures. These contracts are subject to dual CFTC and SEC oversight—not left to grow unchecked, but bringing the crypto world’s familiar “no-expiry perpetuals” into regulated U.S. equity markets.

A few points that matter directly to everyday traders 👇

🔹 How things worked before: Single-stock perpetuals were mostly available on offshore or on-chain platforms. U.S. users either couldn’t access them or had to take on cross-border and counterparty risks. Selig’s basic point was: rather than pushing everyone toward “offshore, often under-regulated” venues, let these products operate within the CFTC framework.

🔹 The requirements now: Not just any app can list them. An exchange must qualify as a CFTC-designated contract market and meet the SEC’s registration requirements for security futures. The statement named no specific exchanges, listed no contracts, and gave no launch date. Coinbase Derivatives and others had already laid groundwork for perpetuals, but who lists first—and which stocks they list—will depend on exchange announcements.

🔹 What the product looks like: There’s no fixed expiry date; funding rates help keep the contract price close to the spot price. Leverage is available, which magnifies gains and losses. These differ from traditional stock-index or single-stock futures that settle at expiry, and they’re not the same as purely event-based prediction contracts.

🔹 The connection to crypto: Earlier this year, the CFTC had already cleared the way for Bitcoin perpetuals on regulated exchanges. This time, the same toolset is being extended from digital commodities to individual stock securities. For crypto users, the significance is that “perpetuals” are no longer a product offered only by offshore venues—regulated U.S. markets are starting to adopt the same approach. But leverage and liquidation rules still depend on each exchange’s documentation.

🔹 Controversies remain: The classification of digital-asset perpetuals by CME and others is still subject to legal disputes, and some Wall Street institutions are also calling for a halt to single-stock perpetuals. The statement doesn’t mean you’ll be able to short Apple with one tap in your usual app tomorrow.

Practical advice: If you’re in the U.S. and interested in single-stock perpetuals, wait for a licensed exchange to announce a public listing, and check the margin, funding-rate, and liquidation rules. Don’t interpret “regulatory approval” as “low risk.” Counterparty and deposit/withdrawal risks on offshore venues are a different matter from those on regulated platforms.

Would you wait for a U.S.-licensed exchange to list single-stock perpetuals, or stick with the crypto perpetuals you already know? Share your thoughts in the comments 👇

content:
想在美国正规盘上做「个股永续」，是不是终于不用再绕去境外？CFTC 主席这回把门框钉实了。

11 月 3 日，美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）主席 Michael Selig 发表声明：按《商品期货现代化法》下的证券期货框架，以及监管规则 40.3，「Equity Perps」（挂钩单只美股的永续期货）可在已向 CFTC 注册、并向 SEC 以通知方式登记交易证券期货的指定合约市场开始挂牌。合约同时受 CFTC 与 SEC 双重监管——不是放任野生长，而是把币圈玩熟的「无到期永续」搬进美股合规盘。

几个和普通人直接相关的点👇

🔹 以前怎么玩：个股永续多在境外或链上平台；美国用户要么够不着，要么要承担跨境与对手方风险。Selig 原话大意是：与其逼着大家去「离岸、往往缺乏监管」的场所，不如让产品在 CFTC 框架里落地。

🔹 现在门槛：不是任意 App 都能上。交易所须同时满足 CFTC 指定合约市场资格，以及 SEC 证券期货相关登记；声明未点名具体所、未列合约清单、也未给上线日——Coinbase Derivatives 等此前已有永续规则布局，但最终谁先挂、挂哪几只股票，以交易所公告为准。

🔹 产品长什么样：无固定到期日，靠资金费率把合约价往现货靠；可杠杆，盈亏会被放大。和「到期交割的传统股指/个股期货」不一样，也和纯事件预测合约不是一回事。

🔹 和加密的衔接：今年 CFTC 已先放过比特币永续上合规所；这次是把同一套工具从数字商品延伸到个股证券。对币圈用户，意义是「永续」不再只是境外所专属话术，美国合规盘也开始接这套玩法——但杠杆与清算规则仍要按各所说明书来。

🔹 争议还在：CME 等对数字资产永续的认定仍有诉讼争议；华尔街部分机构也在对个股永续喊停。声明不等于明天就能在你常用 App 里一键开空苹果股票。

实用建议：人在美国、想碰个股永续，先等持牌所公开上市通知，核对保证金、资金费率与强平规则；别把「监管点头」理解成「低风险」。境外盘的对手方与出入金风险，和合规盘不是同一套账。

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
When trading perpetual contracts, there’s one term you can’t avoid: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and involves
a payment between longs and shorts. The exchange only collects and passes on the money; it doesn’t profit from it.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no expiration date, so how does their price stay in line with the spot price? The answer is the funding rate:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment prevails) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
The money flows between the two sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

Turning 1,000 USDT into a growing account comes down to six steps. I’ll break it all down for you using the lessons I learned the hard way. #ETH 

First, test the waters with small positions. With 1,000 USDT, start by putting just 200–300 USDT into each trade and keep the rest firmly in reserve. I’ve seen too many people go all in right away: when they win, they think they’re born winners; when they lose, they’re badly hurt.

Second, only trade markets you understand. I stick to three rules: support and resistance levels are clear, the higher-timeframe trend is favorable, and the risk-to-reward ratio is at least 2:1. If even one of those is missing, I sit out. There’s no shame in staying flat; opening trades recklessly is what’s shameful.

Third, always set your stop-loss in advance. Keep each trade’s potential loss to 2–3% of your total funds—that’s just 20–30 USDT. If you’re wrong, accept it. Never average down, and don’t think you can double your position to win it all back. That’s a gambler’s approach, not a trader’s.

Fourth, only talk about adding to a position once you’re in profit. First, move your stop-loss up to protect your gains. If the trend is still intact, use some of your profits to add to the position; if the market weakens, scale back immediately. Adding to losing positions is a major mistake, and recklessly adding more when you’re riding high on profits is just as bad.

Fifth, don’t consider increasing your position size until your account is over 3,000 USDT. You can raise the amount per trade to 800–1,000 USDT, but never break your rules. Don’t make a little money and think you’ve become a whole new person—the market has a way of humbling the overconfident.

Sixth, you must withdraw some of your profits. Once your account reaches 3,000 USDT, withdraw 500 USDT and lock it in. No matter how good the numbers on your screen look, if the money isn’t in your pocket, sooner or later it still belongs to the market.

Here’s the honest truth: it’s possible to turn 1,000 USDT into 10,000 USDT with a few lucky breaks, but holding on to it over the long term takes discipline. Stop dreaming of making it all back with one trade. If you can control your drawdowns, hold on to your profits, and resist the urge to overtrade, your account can truly grow.

There’s just one hard-and-fast rule for compounding: use profits to take risks, never gamble your principal.

The FBI requested a block, but THORChain continued processing swaps as usual: this was not nodes “disobeying,” but a structural consequence of permissionless swapping. My view is that as long as the protocol continues to tie node upgrades to transaction validation, without introducing an address-level censorship switch, similar blocking requests will be difficult to implement on-chain. This view depends on the current rules indeed having no mechanism for selective blocking.

First, the facts. According to a THORChain announcement cited by PANews, after the 3.21.1 update, swaps resumed on 11 chains: AVAX, BASE, BCH, BTC, DOGE, ETH, LTC, RUNE, TRON, XRPL, and ZEC. Swaps on ATOM, BSC, and SOL remain paused. The project said that 14 active nodes have yet to upgrade, and that swap performance issues can only be fixed once all active nodes have upgraded. Separately, according to tracking by KOL Grey Ledger, cited by PANews, within 25 minutes of swaps reopening, all 41 swaps linked to the Binance hackers were completed, involving a total of 368.12 ETH, while 1.327 million TRX was returned to the sending wallets. None of the addresses used for these swaps directly matched the FBI list, but 25 of the recipient wallets had previously received ETH from addresses listed by the FBI. Cointelegraph reported that the attackers moved most of the stolen SOL and continued laundering funds through THORChain. On October 31, the FBI had asked THORNode operators to block the related transactions.

My observation is that the key question here is not whether blocking is possible, but at which layer the mechanism for blocking is implemented. If nodes are required to filter transactions against an address list, validators are effectively being asked to make compliance judgments. But if the protocol adheres to uniform rules and has no address-level switch, operators lack an actionable product interface even when they receive a request. Grey Ledger’s claim that “the current rules still do not allow selective blocking” points precisely to this conflict, but the claim comes from a single KOL’s tracking, and the addresses only indirectly match the FBI list. The material available here does not provide a fully verified flow of funds.

Based on this, three things are worth tracking next: when the 14 nodes that have yet to upgrade complete their upgrades, when swaps resume on ATOM/BSC/SOL, and whether the number and flows of swaps involving the related addresses change after services resume. If new filtering rules appear after the node upgrades, or the project explicitly introduces a restricted mode, this assessment will need to be revised. Until then, the tension between “compliance-based blocking” and “protocol neutrality” is likely to recur. This article does not constitute investment advice.

FBI要求拦截，THORChain却照常成交：这不是节点“不听话”，而是无需许可兑换的结构性结果。我的判断是，只要协议仍把节点升级与交易验证绑定、而不引入地址级审查开关，类似的拦截请求就很难在链上落地；这个判断成立的前提，是当前规则确实没有选择性拦截机制。

先看事实。据PANews援引THORChain官方公告，3.21.1版本更新后，AVAX、BASE、BCH、BTC、DOGE、ETH、LTC、RUNE、TRON、XRPL、ZEC共11条链恢复兑换，ATOM、BSC、SOL仍暂停；官方称仍有14个活跃节点未升级，全部活跃节点完成升级后兑换性能问题才能修复。另据PANews援引KOL Grey Ledger的追踪，交易开放后25分钟内，41笔与币安黑客相关的兑换全部成交，共支付368.12枚ETH，另有132.7万枚TRX退回发送钱包；这些兑换地址均未与FBI名单直接匹配，但其中25笔的收款钱包曾向FBI所列地址转入ETH。Cointelegraph报道称，攻击者转移了大部分被盗SOL并继续经THORChain洗币。10月31日FBI曾要求THORNode运营者阻止相关交易。

我的观察是，这里的关键不是“拦不拦得住”，而是拦截在机制上放在哪一层。节点若被要求按地址名单筛选交易，等于让验证者承担合规判断；而协议若坚持统一规则、不设地址级开关，运营者即使收到请求也缺少可执行的产品接口。Grey Ledger所称“现行规则仍无法选择性拦截”，指向的正是这一层冲突，但该说法来自单一KOL追踪，地址与FBI名单也只是间接匹配，本次素材未提供已证实的完整资金路径。

据此推断，接下来值得跟踪三件事：14个未升级节点何时完成升级、ATOM/BSC/SOL何时恢复兑换，以及恢复后相关地址的兑换笔数与流向是否变化。若节点升级后出现新的筛选规则，或官方明确引入受限模式，上述判断就需要修正；在此之前，“合规拦截”与“协议中立”的张力仍会反复出现。本文不构成投资建议。

ETH Transfer Log Proposal | Review Stage, Not Mainnet Launch | I’ll Wait for Confirmation Above 2327

My stance is cautious: I’ll continue watching spot ETH and won’t dress up development discussions as a new feature available today. ETH-related technical topics are not directly trending among Binance Square’s current hot topics or its most-searched topics over the past six hours, and I haven’t seen a corresponding new announcement from Binance News, Research, or OTC. So I’ll stick to verified project developments. Ethereum’s official EIP-7708 page is currently marked “Last Call.” Its goal is to make ETH value transfers automatically leave searchable logs, like ERC-20 transfers. The official motivation is specific: ETH transfers from ordinary externally owned accounts are easy to read from transaction lists, but internal ETH transfers from smart contract wallets do not necessarily produce standardized logs. In the past, this has led some exchanges to provide insufficient support or slower confirmations for deposits from contract wallets. PR #12613, on November 2, continued discussion of the boundary between contract-creation transactions and reverted execution frames: if a transaction fails before a transfer, or an execution frame is reverted, it should not leave behind a valid transfer record.

The proposal matters because of settlement observability. If it is adopted in the future and implemented by clients and platforms, exchanges, wallets, and on-chain analytics tools may be able to identify incoming ETH more consistently, reducing the risk of missing internal transfers or misclassifying failed calls as deposits. But for now, the only confirmed fact is that it is under standards review: the PR is still Open, the page still indicates that author review is needed, and the EIP is at the peer-review stage. This does not mean it has been activated on mainnet today, nor that deposits to all exchanges will now be credited in real time. Even if it goes live in the future, platforms will still need to check address ownership, risk controls, and finality; a log at the code level is no unconditional guarantee that a deposit will be credited. Recent Binance withdrawal resumption has also been rolled out in batches by asset and network, so an Ethereum protocol proposal should not be conflated with the actual status of exchange channels.

Fund flows are still tempering the technical optimism. Farside reports net outflows of $139.7 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 2, followed by another $85.3 million on November 3. ETHA alone saw $74.4 million in outflows on November 3. These figures reflect net subscriptions and redemptions through fund channels; they do not mean that all ETH holders globally are selling. The latest official Federal Reserve decision remains its October 28 decision to hold rates at 3.75%–4%, and I haven’t seen a corresponding new ETH fund approval in the SEC newsroom. I’d rather view the technical roadmap as a long-term convenience factor, and fund flows and platform security as current risk constraints.

The market price has recovered from its lows: I just checked Kraken, where ETH was around $2,317.96, with a daily open of $2,271.67, a low of $2,223.35, and a high of $2,326.90. The price is close to the day’s high, but that doesn’t prove the rise was driven by EIP-7708. The level above at 2327 is the confirmation point; below, first watch 2272, then 2223. If the price breaks out but an hourly candle closes back below 2272, the short-term strengthening thesis is invalidated. If it falls below 2223, today’s rebound structure also fails.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter yet. The only direction I’d consider is a leveraged-free spot long. I’d wait for an hourly close above 2327, a successful retest holding 2315, and normal deposits and withdrawals on Ethereum mainnet before entering in two tranches, using no more than 2% of my total capital. The first target is $2,380 and the second is $2,440. I’d take half off at $2,380 and move the protective stop on the remaining position close to entry. The initial stop would be below 2270. If the hourly candle falls back below 2272, I’d reduce the position; below 2270, I’d close it entirely. I’d also cancel the plan if fund outflows remain significant or platform channels experience disruptions. If the conditions aren’t met, I stay out of the market—I won’t present a plan as a trade that has already been executed.

ETH转账日志提案｜审阅阶段不是主网上线｜我等2327上方确认

我的态度是偏谨慎，继续观察ETH现货，不把开发讨论包装成今天的新功能。币安广场当前热门与六小时最常搜索没有ETH直接上升的技术话题，Binance News、Research、OTC也未见对应新公告，所以只谈已核实的项目进展。以太坊EIP-7708官方页面目前标为Last Call，目标是让ETH价值转移像ERC-20转账那样自动留下可检索日志。官方动机写得很具体：普通外部账户的ETH转账容易从交易列表读取，但智能合约钱包的内部ETH转移不一定有统一日志，过去曾使部分交易所对合约钱包入金支持不足或确认较慢。11月2日的PR #12613继续讨论合约创建交易与回滚执行帧的边界：若交易在转账前失败，或执行帧被回滚，不应凭空留下有效转账记录。

这项提案的重要性在于结算可观察性。若未来被采纳并在客户端和平台完成适配，交易所、钱包与链上分析工具或能更统一地识别ETH到账，减少把内部转账漏计或把失败调用误判成入金的风险。但现在的事实仅是标准审阅：PR仍Open，页面还显示需作者审阅，EIP处于同行评审阶段。它不是主网今天已启用，也不是已经让所有交易所入金实时到账。即便未来上线，平台仍需做地址归属、风控和最终性检查；代码层面的日志不是无条件入账保证。近期币安提现恢复也按资产和网络分批，不能把以太坊协议提案与交易所实际通道状态混为一谈。

资金面仍给技术利好降温。Farside列出的美国ETH现货基金11月2日净流出1.397亿美元、11月3日再流出8530万美元；ETHA在11月3日单独流出7440万美元。该数据反映基金渠道净申赎，不等同全球ETH所有持有人都在卖。美联储最新正式决定仍是10月28日维持利率3.75%至4%，SEC新闻室未见对应的ETH基金新批准。我更愿意把技术路线看作中长期便利性变量，把基金流向与平台安全看作当下风险约束。

市场价格已从低位修复：刚核对Kraken ETH约2317.96美元，日开2271.67，日低2223.35，高2326.90。价格靠近当日高点，却不能证明涨幅由EIP-7708驱动。上方2327是确认位，下方先看2272，再看2223。若突破后小时收盘回到2272下方，短线转强判断被推翻；若跌破2223，今天的反弹结构也失效。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，方向只考虑无杠杆现货试多。等小时收盘站上2327、回踩守住2315，同时ETH主网充提实际正常，再用总资金最多2%分两笔进场。第一目标2380美元，第二目标2440美元；到2380先减一半，剩余仓位把保护位抬至入场附近。初始止损设在2270下方，若小时线跌回2272先减仓，跌破2270全部平仓；若基金继续显著流出或平台通道异常，也取消计划。条件未触发就空仓，不把计划写成已成交。

#ETH

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds required when you open a position. For example, at 10x leverage, it’s 10% of the position size.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin threshold: When losses eat through the maintenance margin requirement, the system begins partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than liquidating it all at once.

📰 A crypto whale is accumulating again—why is Block’s purchase of 120 BTC a key signal?

Block, one of the crypto world’s biggest backers, bought another 120 bitcoins in the third quarter, bringing its total holdings to 9,237. The company has been quietly building its position, and this latest increase shows it isn’t putting all its eggs in one basket. But is it bullish on Bitcoin, or is it buying BTC to pay employees? It’s worth thinking about.

Why does this news matter?
Block’s move is about more than simply buying Bitcoin. It’s now one of the crypto industry’s largest “passive bulls”—essentially saying, “We believe in Bitcoin’s long-term value.” More importantly, its buying strategy is unusual: instead of making one huge purchase, it buys gradually. This reflects two priorities: keeping pace with Bitcoin’s volatility while avoiding getting caught buying at the market’s peak. After exchanges like FTX collapsed, Block offers an example of how large companies can manage digital assets.

Impact on the market
For BTC, quiet buying by an institution like Block can matter more than a big shot posting on Twitter. Block’s purchases signal that Bitcoin is recognized as a valuable long-term holding. But in terms of price, this latest increase may not directly push BTC above $78,378, since Block itself described it as a “strategic allocation.” This means:
- It may give BTC a short-term boost in sentiment, but not the kind of surge sparked by an ETF announcement
- In the medium term, Block’s pattern of continued buying may lead the market to believe that institutions’ average cost of holding Bitcoin is coming down
- There’s no direct spillover to other cryptocurrencies, since Block isn’t buying altcoins

Trading strategy
Block’s buying pattern means Bitcoin has gained another layer of “cushion.” But if you’re looking for a takeaway for your own trades, it’s this: institutional investors’ cost-basis strategies are more useful to watch than their emotional trading. title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated margin and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures contract, you'll be asked to choose “isolated margin” or “cross margin.” Many beginners just tap one at random and end up suffering big losses.

[Cross margin] All the balance in your account is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: in extreme market conditions, losses could wipe out your entire account. It's like putting all your eggs in one
positions prop each other up in the same basket.

[Isolated margin] Only the specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If this position gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and it won't affect other positions or your principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

[My recommendation] Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you don't yet have the ability to assess “the worst-case outcome of a single bad trade

$ETH: Spread Logic in Quiet Hours

Think of the order book as a grocery store shelf. Limit orders are the stocked items, creating liquidity. Market orders grab them instantly, widening the spread if the shelf is thin. Observed 2.62887 and daily quote volume 4.42375e+08 suggest active participation. The hourly direction is up with price above resistance. This does not prove sustainable strength. A rise powered solely by market orders drains liquidity without adding depth. The mechanism relies on the difference between token price and project value. The price reflects immediate supply and demand only. The spread measures how easily you can exit a position. If the spread widens, execution quality drops even if the chart looks strong. Check if the move relies on limit orders building at higher levels. Without that support, the move may reverse quickly when new buyers pause. Use RSI 72.4929 as a secondary gauge, not a primary signal. A high value warns of extended moves, not direction. The real risk is mistaking velocity for conviction. Velocity comes from urgency. Conviction comes from resting orders. Before trusting any smooth move, verify the depth around current levels. Look for stable bid and ask stacks rather than just price action alone. This helps separate genuine demand from temporary pressure. Do not assume that volume alone confirms the trend. Always reassess by watching if new limit orders accumulate or vanish slowly. That distinction protects capital from fakeouts.

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

📰 Why Did Coinbase Add CARDS to Its Listing Roadmap, Sending the Token Up 4%?

Coinbase officially announced that it had added the CARDS token to its list of assets that may be listed in the future. Following the announcement, the price of CARDS immediately rose 4%. The move was seen as recognition of the growing trend of combining digital assets with the real economy, but it will take time to materialize; for now, it is only an initial plan.

Why does this news matter?
The key point about Coinbase’s move is that it is more than a simple boost to market sentiment. As a trendsetter in the crypto industry, the platform’s addition of any asset to its roadmap is interpreted by the market as a signal of potential opportunity. More importantly, the CARDS project aims to build a bridge between digital assets and physical assets, such as real estate and art. This directly addresses regulators’ recent questions about whether NFTs can truly achieve “composability.” Regulators may be more inclined to see tokenization genuinely transfer value, rather than remain at the level of speculation. Coinbase’s recognition gives this direction a degree of “regulatory-friendly” endorsement, at least in terms of signaling.

Market impact
In the short term, the move has mainly boosted confidence in CARDS and projects in the same sector. In the medium term, however, two factors warrant attention: first, whether CARDS can deliver on its value proposition; and second, the actual progress of a Coinbase listing. At this stage, the positive news is largely driven by speculation around the concept, and the 4% rise in CARDS’s price has mostly been absorbed by the market. This suggests investors may be placing more weight on “possibility” than “certainty.” Historically, similar news has had very little direct spillover effect on ETH or other major cryptocurrencies, as asset tokenization is a relatively niche narrative.

Trading perspective
This news suggests that mainstream crypto platforms are beginning to pay attention to the asset tokenization sector, but at this stage, its potential to lift BTC or ETH prices is limited. Coinbase’s recognition is more like confirmation of a general direction than a signal of direct liquidity inflows. If concrete examples of cooperation between CARDS and traditional financial assets emerge in the future, the case for this narrative will have a stronger foundation. If regulators suddenly tighten restrictions on asset tokenization, or the CARDS project itself fails to deliver on its promises, this thesis will quickly unravel.

ETH touches 2313 | Account abstraction post-quantum proposal still a draft | I’m waiting for a breakout and retest

My stance is cautious. The strengthening market is worth tracking, but I wouldn’t buy based on claims that a “post-quantum upgrade is live.” Today, the Ethereum EIPs repository added PR #12616, titled “Add Lean SPHINCS-related design to EIP-8141 framework transactions.” The submitter explicitly says it is “an initial outline of a possible way to add this.” The page is marked Draft and has not been merged. EIP-8141 itself is also at the standards-draft stage. It describes splitting transaction validation, execution, and gas payment into different frameworks to enable more flexible account validation and key rotation in the future. Ethereum’s official security roadmap likewise lists post-quantum security as a long-term preparation effort; it does not announce that the current mainnet is under quantum attack or that a migration was completed today. Separating a draft from something already active on mainnet is the first step in assessing this news.

Why does this matter for ETH? If the standard, clients, wallets, and ecosystem applications are adopted in stages in the future, account security and the payment experience could improve, and developers may increase on-chain activity. But the process would involve review, implementation, testing, upgrades, and user adoption. Today’s PR itself does not create certain buying demand for ETH, nor does it translate directly into token demand. Another real-world constraint to watch is fund flows: Farside’s table shows net outflows of about $85.3 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 3, and about $139.7 million on November 2. Long-term benefits from project development can coexist with short-term institutional outflows; one draft cannot erase the outflow data. title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100U control 1,000U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people just getting started ask me: does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

[The basics] Leverage is when the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100U in principal and use 10x leverage, you actually control
a position worth 1,000U. If the coin price rises by 1%, you make 10% on your principal; conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—remember, the loss is calculated based on your total position, including borrowed funds.

[The cost] With 10x leverage, if the coin price moves against you by about 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It’s not
that you only lose everything after a 10% drop; a drop of about 10% is enough to wipe it all out (the exact threshold also depends on the margin ratio).

The chain of interests behind the Binance hack: Are we seeing the truth, or just the tip of the iceberg?

On October 31, the U.S. FBI issued a statement officially attributing the theft of more than $6 billion in crypto assets from Binance to the North Korean hacking group TraderTraitor.
Park Jin Hyok, pictured here, is one of the North Korean hackers previously named in an FBI wanted notice and is linked to North Korea’s Lazarus hacking group.
It is worth noting that the U.S. has currently identified the TraderTraitor group, but has not confirmed that Park Jin Hyok himself was directly involved in this Binance attack.
Even more alarming, the attack reportedly involved fake job offers and malicious software, and even exploited internal AI tools to gain system access.
This is no longer just a simple exchange security issue; it is a security challenge that the entire crypto industry must face.
Two questions are worth considering:
1️⃣ If even the world’s leading exchanges could fall victim to an attack of this magnitude, how can ordinary investors’ assets be protected?
2️⃣ As AI technology becomes increasingly powerful, will the crypto industry’s security defenses be able to keep up when hackers use AI to launch attacks in the future?
After this incident, do you think people will still trust centralized exchanges as they did before?

【Like ETH at the end of 2018: hated by everyone after the drop, but the market stabilized first】

During the 2018 downturn, ETH was the first to slump, and the market was afraid to buy. This cycle looks similar: $2,296, up 2.2% in 24 hours and down 2.2% over 7 days, with the Fear Index at 34. Even amid the panic, there’s still buying support and trading activity hasn’t dried up. This looks more like bottoming consolidation than a signal that a rally is starting.

I expect consolidation for three reasons: First, the market rebounded despite a Fear Index reading of 34, showing a divergence in sentiment. Second, BTC dominance is 59.4%, and capital is still concentrated mainly in BTC, leaving ETH without an independent source of new inflows. Third, Binance’s disclosure of a $6.3 billion attack involving EIP-7702 could dampen institutional risk appetite in the short term. THORChain’s resumption of most cross-chain swaps shows the system can be repaired, not that the risks have disappeared.

In practice, exchanges, cross-chain protocols, and ecosystem developers are taking the biggest hit: anyone who confuses “the code runs” with “the assets are safe” will learn an expensive lesson. The business implication is that audits, isolation measures, and compensation will shift from being costs to becoming prerequisites for winning business.

What would show that I’m wrong? If ETH breaks above this week’s rebound high on strong volume and the Fear Index rises, the outlook turns bullish. If it breaks below this week’s low on strong volume, the outlook turns bearish.

Which side do you trust more? Come back next week and we’ll compare notes. What’s your view? ➡️Consolidation

content:
【像2018年底的ETH：跌到人人嫌，行情却先稳住了】

2018年那轮，ETH先趴下、市场怕买；这轮也像：2296美元，24小时涨2.2%，7日跌2.2%，恐惧指数34。恐慌中仍有承接、成交不冷，更像底部震荡，不是启动信号。

我判断震荡，逻辑有三条：一，恐惧指数34却出现反弹，市场情绪形成背离；二，BTC占比59.4%，资金仍以BTC为主仓，ETH缺少独立增量；三，币安披露的63亿美元攻击牵涉EIP-7702，短期会压低机构风险偏好。THORChain重启多数跨链交换说明系统能修，不等于风险消失。

落到实处，交易所、跨链协议和生态开发者最受伤：谁把“代码能跑”当成“资产安全”，谁就要交学费。商业逻辑是，审计、隔离、赔付会从成本变成订单门槛。

什么情况说明我错了？若ETH放量突破本周反弹高点且恐惧指数回升，方向转多；若放量跌破本周低点，方向转空。

你更信哪一边？下周回来对答案。你的判断是？➡️震荡

📰 Why are voters still unconvinced? Crypto’s trust crisis ahead of the U.S. election

CoinDesk ran a poll and found that ordinary people still have a strong aversion to cryptocurrency. Some have never heard of it, while others simply don’t think it’s trustworthy—especially when it comes to regulation. With the U.S. election drawing closer, it’s hard for crypto to have much political influence, and that could directly affect whether it ever takes off.

Why does this news matter?
The root of the problem is that cryptocurrency is so new that people don’t understand it or trust it. Regulation is a particular concern: policies vary widely across jurisdictions, with some places welcoming crypto and others cracking down on it. Ordinary people can’t make sense of whom to listen to. Voters’ lack of confidence shows that crypto still needs to overcome the trust barrier before it can enter the mainstream. This is tied to people being more sensitive to risk during the current bear market, as well as to several major projects running into trouble recently.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this could weigh on sentiment around BTC and ETH. ETH has rallied strongly lately, but given the public’s attitude, could trust concerns trigger another drop? More broadly, if regulations remain unclear, institutional investors won’t dare to commit large sums, making it even harder for crypto to become a mainstream financial product.

How to approach it
Honestly, market sentiment matters more than prices right now. If clear, positive regulatory signals emerge over the next few months—for example, a clear direction for development—this pessimism may gradually ease. If things remain this murky, I’m not optimistic.

This article was not sponsored by any project team, and the author does not hold any of the assets mentioned.

translatedData.content:
Ethereum Foundation discusses public digital infrastructure | Adoption doesn't equal buying pressure | I'm waiting for 2305 confirmation

My position is that I recognize real-world usage, but remain cautious about how it translates into token prices. On November 3, the Ethereum Foundation published a feature on public digital infrastructure, describing how governments, NGOs, and public service organizations use open networks for cross-institutional verification. It also launched a dedicated resource site for the public sector. One example in the article is Bhutan's national digital identity system: individuals store credentials in their wallets and decide for themselves which information to share, while service providers verify the issuer using shared registry information on Ethereum. Personal data itself does not need to be publicly written to the blockchain. The Foundation's case study page also makes clear that issuing or verifying a credential does not necessarily require an Ethereum transaction each time. This is a description of an existing application—not an announcement that a nation bought ETH today, and certainly not a promise from the Foundation of a particular amount of on-chain fees.

Why should traders pay attention to this kind of information? It demonstrates how public blockchains can be used when “multiple institutions need to verify information together without relying on a single database.” If more services use them over time, demand for developers, wallets, identity protocols, and settlement could grow, potentially benefiting the Ethereum ecosystem in the long term. But actual demand for ETH depends on how many operations settle on mainnet, which layer-2 networks are used, who pays the fees, and whether usage can be sustained at scale. A successful identity verification might only involve reading registry data, and may not correspond to a new on-chain transaction. The Bhutan case study also emphasizes that on-chain registry information only supports technical verification; who is qualified to issue valid credentials remains a matter of local governance. Technology can improve coordination, but it cannot replace institutional accountability.

For now, the market is more constrained by capital flows and risk appetite. Farside's figures show net outflows of $85.3 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 3, U.S. time. That was down from $139.7 million on November 2, but flows remained negative. These are daily subscription and redemption figures, not evidence of current spot selling on a trade-by-trade basis. Kraken ETH/USD is currently around $2,292, with a daily open of $2,272, an intraday low of $2,223, and a high of about $2,305 over the past 24 hours. The price has rebounded from its low while fund flows remain net negative. This suggests there is short-term support, but also shows that “growing public-sector adoption” cannot directly explain today's rise. Binance withdrawals are still being restored in stages by asset and network; actual ETH availability depends on the official status page and individual accounts.

The key short-term level is $2,305. Only an hourly close decisively above it, followed by a retest that holds between $2,290 and $2,305, would show that buyers are willing to support the price at higher levels. Below that, watch $2,272 and $2,223. If the price breaks below $2,272 and remains unable to recover it, the strength of the rebound needs to be reassessed; if it breaks below $2,223, my short-term cautiously stable outlook is invalidated. If fund flows worsen significantly again, I would also reduce my bullish bias. The long-term value of public infrastructure and short-term fund flows operate on different time scales; they cannot be combined into a guarantee of an “immediate breakout.”

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. The only direction I would consider is a small, unleveraged spot position to test a long, using no more than 2% of total capital. The entry trigger is an hourly close above $2,305, followed by a retest that holds between $2,290 and $2,305, with Ethereum mainnet and exchange deposits and withdrawals operating normally. The first target is $2,345, where I would reduce the position by half; the second target is $2,390, where I would close the remainder in stages. The initial stop-loss would be below $2,268. If, after entry, the hourly chart falls back below $2,290 and buying support weakens, I would exit the entire position early. If new official information changes my understanding of the application's scale, or ETF flows worsen significantly, I would immediately cancel the plan. If the conditions are not met, I will remain flat and will not invent a trade.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度是认可真实使用，但对币价传导保持克制。以太坊基金会11月3日发布公共数字基础设施专题，介绍政府、非政府组织和公共服务机构如何使用开放网络做跨机构核验，并推出专门的公共部门资料站。文中举不丹国家数字身份系统为例：个人在钱包中保存凭证，自主决定分享哪些信息，服务机构通过以太坊上的共享注册信息核验签发方；个人资料本身不需要公开写入链上。基金会的案例页也明确，凭证并非每次签发或验证都必须发生一笔以太坊交易。这是已有应用的介绍，不是今天刚宣布国家买入ETH，更不是基金会承诺带来多少链上手续费。

为什么这类信息值得交易员看？它展示了公链在“多个机构共同核验、又不依赖单一数据库”场景中的用途。若更多服务持续使用，开发者、钱包、身份协议和结算需求可能扩大，长期或有利于以太坊生态。可是实际ETH需求要看有多少操作在主网结算、采用哪类二层网络、谁支付手续费，以及规模能否持续。一次成功的身份核验可能只读注册数据，未必对应新增链上交易。不丹案例页还强调，链上注册信息只帮助技术验证，谁有资格签发真实凭证仍由当地治理规则决定。技术能提高协作能力，却不能替代机构责任。

市场当下更受资金和风险偏好制约。Farside汇总美国时间11月3日ETH现货基金净流出8530万美元，较11月2日的1.397亿美元收窄但仍为负值；这是日度申赎记录，不等于此刻的现货逐笔抛压。Kraken ETH/USD现报约2292美元，日开2272美元，日内低点2223美元，最近24小时高点约2305美元。价格从低位回升而基金继续净流出，说明短线有承接，也说明“公共部门采用扩大”不能直接解释今天的上涨。币安提现恢复仍按资产和网络分阶段，涉及ETH的实际可用性还要看官方状态页与个人账户。

短线关键位是2305美元，小时收盘有效站上后回踩2290至2305美元守住，才说明买方愿意在高位承接。下方看2272美元与2223美元。若跌破2272美元并持续无法收回，修复力度要重估；若跌破2223美元，我对短线偏稳的观察失效。基金流量若再度显著恶化，也要降低看多权重。公共基础设施的长期价值和基金短线流量是不同时间尺度，不能拼成“马上突破”的保证。

233 million XRP moved in 4 minutes—the most damning line in Binance’s report is “This should not have happened”!

Binance’s investigation report on the October 30 security incident!
Binance has released its investigation report on the October 30 incident. The most gut-wrenching line wasn’t the loss figure, but the words: “This should not have happened.”

The chain of events actually began back in June. A member of a wallet development team downloaded a tampered tool from an ad; the malicious version appeared above the legitimate one in search results. The platform discovered it, replaced the device, and changed the password—but the person’s access privileges were never revoked. In September, a second engineer downloaded a malicious code repository after a fake job interview that even included a video call with the CEO of a fictional company. On October 20, the attackers used an internal AI tool to gain access to two wallet development machines. On October 29, they moved 233.46 million XRP out of five hot wallets in four minutes, using 50 signed transactions.

What really sent a chill down my spine was the timeline: nearly four hours passed between the first and last unauthorized transfers. About $2.85 billion was frozen during that time, but the process for revoking authorization had been improvised and was a beat too slow.

Afterward, Binance said it had replenished about 95% of the assets. The remaining 5% consisted of illiquid tokens, which it was still sourcing over the counter. The data also gave it some credit: net outflows exceeded $7 billion on Monday, followed by $2.3 billion in net inflows over the next 24 hours, with hourly deposits once again exceeding withdrawals. This year, it has stopped 57 North Korea-linked attacks. The FBI also attributed this incident to North Korea—yet in the end, it was a hiring process that brought them down.

My take is that you can’t pin the blame for this entirely on the hackers. An exchange’s traditional defenses are deep pockets, lots of cold wallets, and a fast response. But this time, none of those three failed because of the technology. They failed because of process: user access privileges, poisoned ad placements, and the boundaries around how internal AI tools can be used. Filling a $6.3 billion-sized hole only takes money. Making up for those four hours of response time requires rewriting the organization.

Whose side are you on? After something like this, should exchanges keep using profits and insurance funds to make users whole and earn their trust, or should users have been keeping their large holdings in their own wallets all along?
#Binance #BTC #ETH #bnb

币安10·30安全事件调查报告！
Binance 把 10·30 事件的调查报告发出来了，最扎心的一句不是损失数字，是那句「This should not have happened」。
链条其实从 6 月就开始了。一名钱包开发团队成员下载了被篡改的工具，来源是一条广告，恶意版本在搜索结果里排在正版前面。平台发现了，换了设备、改了密码，但人的权限没收回来。9 月，第二名工程师在一场假面试后下载了恶意代码库，面试里还有虚构公司的 CEO 视频连线。10 月 20 日，攻击者借内部 AI 工具拿到了两台钱包开发机；10 月 29 日，4 分钟内从 5 个热钱包转走 2.3346 亿枚 XRP，用了 50 笔签名交易。
真正让我后背发凉的是时间线，第一笔到最后一笔未经授权的转账，中间隔了将近 4 小时。期间冻结了约 28.5 亿美元，但撤销授权的流程是临时搭的，慢了一拍。
事后 Binance 说已补上约 95% 的资产，剩下的 5% 是流动性差的代币，还在场外找货。数据也给了它一点面子，周一净流出超 70 亿美元，随后 24 小时净流入 23 亿美元，每小时充值量重新超过提现量。今年拦下 57 起朝鲜相关的攻击，FBI 也把这次事件归到朝鲜头上，最后还是栽在一次招聘上。
我的看法是，这笔账不能只算在黑客头上。交易所的护城河一直是钱多、冷钱包多、反应快，可这次三道都没输在技术上，输在流程上，人的权限、广告位的投毒、内部 AI 工具的调用边界。补 63 亿美元级的窟窿只需要资金，补这 4 小时的反应时间，得重写组织。
你站哪边：这种事之后，交易所该继续用利润和保险基金兜底换信任，还是用户本来就该把大额资产放回自己的钱包？

AP fills in the final piece: Democrats retake the House, confirming a sweep of both chambers | Afternoon, Nov. 4

Keep this separate from the 13:38 post: AP had officially called the Senate in that one, while the House was still “too early to call.” This post fills in the House result—both the Wall Street Journal and MarketWatch live pages quoted AP as saying Democrats had retaken the House. With that, AP has called control of both chambers; this is no longer just a media projection.

This is exactly the opening left in the previous post: it said, “If this conflicts with NBC’s projection of about 255 seats, disregard this post’s House call.” Now AP’s announcement is in line with NBC’s projection, and the estimate of about 255 seats hasn’t been overturned. The final seat count is still being tallied; 218 is the threshold for a majority, and the new Congress takes office on Jan. 3. The numbers could still shift by a few seats, but control is no longer in doubt.

Another seat was called in the same window: at 1:02 a.m. Eastern time, AP called Maine’s Senate race for Democrat Troy Jackson, ending Republican Susan Collins’ nearly 30-year tenure. AP still hasn’t called Michigan’s Senate race, but the Senate majority no longer depends on it.

For crypto markets, the variables only really come into play now that the picture is complete. By TD Cowen’s earlier analysis, with Democrats controlling Congress, the CLARITY Act will be harder to pass over the next two years; Warren could chair the Senate Banking Committee, and Waters could chair the House Financial Services Committee. Winning the House also gives Democrats subpoena power through the House Oversight Committee, which could investigate the Trump family’s crypto ties. But the president still has veto power, so executive-branch deregulation will be difficult to overturn directly through legislation. So a “sweep” doesn’t mean the bill will pass right away, much less that it’s an immediate bullish catalyst.

Here’s an initial market reference point: before publication, I cross-checked two sources. $BTC  was around $77,997, up about 1.54% over 24 hours, with an intraday low of $75,736; $ETH  was around $2,296, up about 1.81% over 24 hours. That’s another step up from the 13:39 check ($77,640 / $2,290), but don’t mistake the election-night results being settled for an immediate trend reversal.

My view in one sentence: with control of both chambers settled, the CLARITY fight shifts from “who gets to decide” to “how long will it take, and what will the final version look like?” That’s a slow-moving variable for the market, not a bullish catalyst you can trade on tonight.

Risk warning: the final seat count and results in races not yet called could still change this assessment. Election results are not investment advice; price volatility remains high, so watch your position size.

美联社补上最后一块：民主党夺回众议院，两院横扫坐实｜11月4日午后

跟13:38那篇要区分开：那篇参议院是美联社的正式宣布、众议院还是“为时尚早”；这篇补上的是众议院——华尔街日报与MarketWatch直播页均引述美联社称，民主党已夺回众议院。至此两院控制权都由美联社定性，不再是媒体预测。

这正好兑现了上一帖留的口子：当时写的是“若与NBC约255席预测相左，本帖众议院口径作废”——现在美联社的宣布与NBC预测方向一致，约255席的估算没有被推翻。最终席位数仍在计票中，218席是多数门槛，新国会1月3日就职，数字还可能动几席，但归属不再悬。

同窗口还有一席落定：美联社在美东时间凌晨1:02 call缅因参议院给民主党人Troy Jackson，共和党人Susan Collins近30年的任期就此结束。密歇根参议院席位美联社仍未call，不过参议院多数早已不依赖它。

对加密市场来说，拼图齐了之后变量才真正开始：按此前TD Cowen的分析口径，民主党掌控国会后，CLARITY法案未来两年更难通过，沃伦有望执掌参议院银行委员会、沃特斯有望执掌众议院金融服务委员会；众议院到手还意味着民主党拿到众议院监督委员会的传票权，可能调查特朗普家族的加密关联。但总统否决权还在，行政层面的放松监管很难被立法直接推翻。所以“横扫”不等于“法案立刻通过”，更不等于“立刻利好”。

盘面先给个锚：发稿前双信源核对，$BTC 约77,997美元，24小时约+1.54%，日内低点75,736美元；$ETH 约2,296美元，24小时约+1.81%。比13:39那次核对（77,640／2,290）又往上走了一截，但别把选举夜尘埃落定直接当成趋势反转。

我的看法就一句：两院归属落定，CLARITY的博弈才从“谁说了算”变成“拖多久、改成什么样”，这对行情是慢变量，不是今晚就能交易的利好。

风险提示：最终席位数、未call席位结果仍可能修正上述判断；选举结果不构成任何投资建议，价格波动仍大，注意仓位。

两院都换手之后，你觉得CLARITY是拖得更久，还是反而逼出一个折中版本？

title: ETH ETF 十月流出16亿：慢性失血还是黄金坑
subTitle:
$ETH 十月被 ETF 抽走 16.1 亿美元，我把这笔账摊开讲讲。

先说结论：这不是一天两天的恐慌，是一整个月的慢性失血。

1. 数据先摆出来
・美国现货 ETH ETF 十月净流出 16.07 亿美元，创上市以来单月纪录，前纪录是去年 11 月的 14.24 亿。
・十月只有 3 天小额净流入，其余基本全是流出。
・贝莱德 ETHA 一家就占了约 88%（约 14.2 亿）。
・11 月 2 日又流出 1.4 亿，连续第 6 个交易日净流出。
・ETH 十月跌了约 16%，月初约 2685，月底约 2254，10 月 30 日探到约 2150~2170。

2. 为什么我觉得这件事比价格本身更重要
上个季度 ETF 还连着三个月净流入 30 亿美元左右，现在直接翻过来。
机构资金一进一出，ETH 的"边际买家"就换了人。
再叠加币安 10·29 那场大事件，情绪面本来就脆。

3. 日线怎么看（ETHUSDT 1d，数据来自币安现货）
・现价 2296.29，近 100 根日线区间 1822.06 ~ 2807.34。
・布林带：上轨 2488.91 / 中轨 2346.08 / 下轨 2203.26。
・现在价格贴着中轨下方、下轨上方，属于"弱势整理"。

关键位：
・关键位 1：2203（日线布林下轨）。收盘跌穿，说明 10 月 30 日那个低点守不住。
・关键位 2：2346（中轨）。站回去，空头才算被打断。
・失效条件：日线连续两根收盘站上 2346 且 ETF 单日转为净流入，我就认错，不再说偏弱。

4. 我的看法
短期偏谨慎。资金流没转正之前，反弹我只当反弹。
但也别极端：ETF 累计净流入仍有约 122.9 亿美元，不是资金全跑光，是增量没了。
下一个观察点很简单：每天盯 ETF 流向，连续两天转正，才是真正的信号。

最后问你一句：$ETH 现在是"等 ETF 转正再说"，还是"2200 附近就敢接"？评论区说说你的选择。

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Does “Fuel for the Blockchain” Mean?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay Gas fees to transfer funds or mint an NFT—but who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transfers, trades, running
contracts) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of Gas).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → skyrocketing Gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

Getting liquidated isn’t scary. What’s scary is still thinking you can win it all back afterward.
The scariest thing about futures isn’t getting liquidated. It’s getting liquidated and still thinking you can win it all back.
Why do some people refuse to walk away even after losing all their principal? Put simply, it’s not that they can’t read the market—they just can’t accept losing.
You work for a month and earn 10,000, exhausting yourself for 30 days. But with high leverage, a 1% move against you could theoretically wipe out your 10,000 in principal. In practice, it also depends on margin and liquidation rules, but that’s how brutal the scale can be. Making money too quickly makes you think you’re just one more trade away from turning things around. You don’t consider that the faster you make money, the faster you could lose it.
There are three types of people most likely to get burned: those who lose money and try to win it back, those who keep adding to their positions after losing, and those who take profits at the first small gain but stubbornly hold on when they’re losing. You’re bound to be one of these three, and even then, you’ll think it was the market’s fault. Which one are you?
I’ve always believed that trading crypto isn’t about who makes the most money, but about who lasts the longest. When trading futures, use less leverage, manage your position size, and set your stop-loss in advance. Never put your living expenses or borrowed money into it. When your meal money is tied up in a futures trade, you’ll be a beat late on your stop-loss—and a beat is all it takes.
The market is full of stories about people getting rich overnight. What it lacks are people who can make money and hold on to it. If you can’t hold on to it, no matter how good the story is, it belongs to someone else.
When you trade futures, are you really trying to make money, or are you just refusing to accept a loss? Let’s talk in the comments. I only care whether you set a stop-loss for this trade, not how much you want to win back. Review your losses and look for what you could have done differently. Don’t blame the market, and definitely don’t shift the blame to anyone else! I’m Long Ge, a guy who worked his way up from humble beginnings. #ETH

Beyond buying crypto on licensed platforms, custodians who manage your private keys and advisers who give you trading recommendations will also need separate licences in Hong Kong—and a draft bill is due this year.

At the main forum of Hong Kong FinTech Week on November 3, Christopher Hui, Deputy Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, made clear that, in line with the direction set out in the Policy Statement on the Development of Digital Assets in Hong Kong 2.0, the Government will establish a licensing regime for virtual asset trading, custody, advisory and management services, and submit an amendment bill to the Legislative Council in 2026. On November 4, in response to a question in the Legislative Council, he confirmed again that the Government and the Securities and Futures Commission plan to amend the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (Cap. 615), extending the existing regulation of virtual asset trading platforms to cover these four types of services. The aim is to submit the bill before the end of the year.

A few points that directly affect everyday users 👇

🔹 The custody licence focuses on “who holds your private keys”: The proposed regime targets risks relating to the safekeeping in Hong Kong of clients’ virtual asset private keys (or instruments that can transfer assets unilaterally). Managing your own private keys in a personal cold wallet would generally not fall within the scope of this licence. Whether arrangements such as MPC require a licence will depend on whether clients can independently retrieve their assets, and will be assessed case by case.

🔹 The advisory licence is modelled on the traditional Type 4 licence (advising on securities): Providing advice in the course of business on whether to buy or sell virtual assets, what to buy, when to buy, or on what terms—or publishing analysis reports for that purpose—will in principle require a licence. Repackaging substantive recommendations as “education” or “signals” won’t get around the rules.

🔹 Management services are modelled on Type 9: Discretionary management of clients’ virtual asset portfolios will require a licence, and the proposal would not provide a minimum-value exemption. Trading services, meanwhile, are modelled on Type 1 and will be aligned with the existing VATP regime.

🔹 A red line on promotion: In principle, anyone who is not licensed or registered may not actively promote these services to the Hong Kong public, whether in Hong Kong or from overseas. The official position also does not intend to grant existing operators “deemed licensed” transitional status. Instead, an appropriate commencement date will be set, and early preparation of applications will be encouraged.

🔹 Where the pieces fit: Licences for trading platforms are already in place (around 13 platforms have been publicly identified as licensed), and two stablecoin issuer licences have been issued. This step adds custody, advisory and management to the same compliance framework—it’s not just a standalone “positive catalyst” announcement.

Put simply, this is a legislative timetable for deciding whether “people who hold private keys and people who give trading advice need an SFC licence.” The bill still has to pass through the Legislative Council, and the final rules will depend on the enacted ordinance. If you keep your coins with a third-party custodian or place trades based on paid advice, keep an eye on whether the provider is licensed, whether client assets are segregated, and whether its promotional claims cross the line.

Would you rather keep your coins with a licensed custodian, or stick to managing them yourself with a cold wallet? Let’s talk in the comments 👇

content:
在持牌平台买币之外，帮你管私钥的托管商、给你买卖建议的顾问，香港也要单独发牌了——今年内就交草案。

11 月 3 日香港金融科技周主论坛上，财经事务及库务局副局长陈浩濂明确表态：按《数字资产发展政策宣言 2.0》方向，政府将就虚拟资产交易、托管、提供意见及管理服务设立发牌制度，并在 2026 年内向立法会提交修订条例草案。11 月 4 日他在立法会答复提问时再确认：政府和证监会拟修订《打击洗钱及恐怖分子资金筹集条例》（第 615 章），把现有虚拟资产交易平台监管扩展到上述四类服务，目标年底前提交草案。

几个和普通人直接相关的点👇

🔹 托管牌照盯的是「谁握着你的私钥」：拟议制度聚焦在香港保管客户虚拟资产私钥（或可单方面转移资产的工具）相关风险；自己冷钱包自管私钥，通常不在这张牌的业务定义里。MPC 等安排是否要牌，看客户能不能独立取回资产，按个案判断

🔹 顾问牌照对标传统第 4 类（就证券提供意见）：以业务形式就该不该买/卖、买什么、何时买、按什么条款买虚拟资产给意见，或为此发分析报告，原则上要持牌；把实质建议包装成「教育」「信号」也过不了关

🔹 管理服务对标第 9 类：代客酌情管理虚拟资产投资组合要牌，且拟议不设最低额豁免；交易服务则对标第 1 类，与现有 VATP 制度衔接

The threat quantum computing poses to blockchain systems is no mere speculation. For the crypto market as a whole, proactive defenses by leading projects may indirectly improve the industry’s image of resilience, potentially having a positive effect on market sentiment.
